title: Muryar Hikima a Cikin Inuwar
intro: Wani mutum daga zamanin da, wanda aka san shi da zurfin fahimta, yana yi maka magana tsawon ƙarni da yawa. Wannan mutumin bai taɓa yin da'awar annabci ba, amma hikimar Allah ta ratsa ta cikin kalmominsa. Iyaye waɗanda suka bar gadon jagora na har abada, shawarwarinsu suna nan a cikin zukatan miliyoyin mutane, ana karantawa kuma ana tunawa da su har zuwa yau.
clues: Na sami wata baiwa ta allahntaka wadda ta bambanta ni - wata hikima mai zurfi wadda ta zama siffa ta ta musamman a tsawon tarihi.
Ban kasance manzo ba kuma mala'ika - kawai rai mai albarka da zurfin fahimta da fahimta game da duniya.
Ƙaunar da ta fi kusa da ni ita ce ta ɗana, kuma ta wannan haɗin gwiwa, an isar da saƙona mafi ɗorewa.
Na yi kira ga godiya ga Wanda ya ba ni komai, kuma na yi gargaɗi game da girman kai da girman kai.
Na koyar game da nauyin ayyukan da ko da ƙwayar mustard take da shi, da kuma muhimmancin rage muryar mutum cikin tawali'u.
Babi a cikin Alqur'ani mai ɗauke da sunana, inda aka kiyaye shawarar da na ba wa ɗana ƙaunatacce har abada.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
